messages:
alex: Vendor update — carrier hit customs in FRA. 16 H100s delayed, new ETA 2024-04-02. AWB `CNL123456789`.
priya: how many of those are reserved for eu-dedicated pool?
alex: 12 were reserved for eu-dedicated, 4 assigned to infra spare pool. If delay holds we'll drop ~10% throughput for a few days on eu-west dedicated.
luis: can we temp-route some workloads to us-west to cover P95? latency hit but avoids throttles.
priya: prefer to avoid cross-region for customers on reserved capacity — any route alternatives? AMS staging? 
vendor-desk: Forwarder says FRA customs can clear same-day if we provide commercial invoice tweak and promise of return AWB. Re-route to AMS adds 18h transit + €1,200 brokerage. We can consolidate into 2 pallets for AMS.
maria: there's also a partial RMA note — 3 serials flagged DOA on arrival inspection report. Serial IDs: `H100-01A`, `H100-01B`, `H100-01C`.
ops-bot: Ticket #INF-4621 created: "FRA customs hold + 3 DOA serials" by alex.
priya: if vendor covers brokerage we can approve AMS re-route. If not, we take the ETA hit.
vendor-desk: We can absorb brokerage if you commit to a follow-on top-off order of 8 units by EOM. Otherwise standard surcharge applies.
luis: ops note — if we approve re-route, please mark the 3 DOA units as quarantined in inventory and do not provision until serial reconciliation done.
alex: agreed. priya, want me to ok re-route on your behalf if vendor takes brokerage?
priya: yes, ok to re-route and vendor absorbs brokerage. Also open RMA claim for the 3 DOAs; vendor to provide RMA labels + pre-paid AWB within 48h. 
vendor-desk: Confirmed — we will send RMA labels and will commit follow-on 8-unit top-off PO. ETA to AMS now 2024-03-30 22:00Z, FRA clearance window 2024-03-30 08:00Z-18:00Z. Will DM tracking once booked. :thumbsup:
alex: thanks — I'll update infra schedule and hold provisioning for the 3 serials. Will also create canary shift for eu-dedicated workloads overnight to smooth P95.
priya: tagging @maria for inventory reconciliation when RMA labels arrive.
maria: got it, will reconcile and mark quarantine flow. will post final inventory change in #inventory-sync.
